claim_summary: Time-RA defines a multimodal anomaly-diagnosis task and supplies RAT S 40K feedback-refined reasoning data plus supervised fine-tuning and evaluation for LLMs.

modules.name: TIME-RA structured anomaly diagnosis task
modules.scope_reason: The procedure embeds the anomaly-diagnosis output requirement: binary detection, anomaly class and explanatory thought; changing the task family would require redesigning those outputs and the structured stages.
rubric_path: R3_1_TSK:yes - task-specific anomaly detection, classification and explanation outputs

evidence.quote: reformats these inputs as structured prompts and fine-tunes LLMs, guiding them
into Observation, Thought, and Action stages.

modules.name: RAT S 40K multimodal reasoning dataset
modules.scope_reason: This is training data built for LLM fine-tuning, combining time series, contextual text, visual representations and reasoning annotations that supervise anomaly analysis.
rubric_path: R2:LLM - training data built to train the model

evidence.quote: We first collect multimodal time series anomaly data, incorporating numeric time series, descriptive text, and visualization images.
we leverage LLMs to automatically annotate each time series segment with a reasoning explanation and an anomaly category.

modules.name: GPT-4 feedback annotation pipeline
modules.scope_reason: The pipeline ranks and critiques anomaly-reasoning outputs using task-specific criteria and updates the reusable dataset; changing the task family would require changing its anomaly definitions, feedback prompts and selection criterion.
rubric_path: R3_1_TSK:yes - anomaly reasoning is the selection and feedback objective
R4:Planning and Orchestration; Optimization and Evolution

evidence.quote: After generating 158,340 model completions from 36,311 univariate and 3,274 multivariate instructions, we use GPT-4 to provide two kinds of feedback for each
After generating feedback through GPT-4, we merge the feedback results with the top-ranked results in the model pool

modules.name: RAT S 40K supervised fine-tuning
modules.scope_reason: The method updates language-model parameters by supervised fine-tuning on RAT S 40K multimodal inputs and outputs for anomaly labels, actions and reasoning.
rubric_path: R2:LLM - supervised fine-tuning updates model parameters

evidence.quote: In T IME -RA task, we address these limitations by fine-tuning LLMs with our unique RAT S 40K dataset.

modules.name: Detection, category and explanation evaluation
modules.scope_reason: The evaluation protocol embeds task-specific validation criteria for binary anomaly labels, anomaly actions and textual reasoning, so its metrics must be redesigned for another task family.
rubric_path: R3_1_TSK:yes - validation criteria are anomaly-task outputs

evidence.quote: we adopt a multifaceted evaluation approach, considering three distinct aspects of anomaly detection
employ standard metrics such as precision (P), recall (R), and F1-score (F1) for evaluation.

task_performance.quote: employ standard metrics such as precision (P), recall (R), and F1-score (F1) for evaluation.
